lina-sales: Quick presales ask from DataLock. Two-week EU-only POC. They need: signed subprocessors list, a routing path note for auditors proving no non-EU hops, BYO-KMS pricing line, and a short hosted vs dedicated cost delta. Can we triage?
omar-se: Clarify traffic shape? sustained RPS and spikes? Is BYO-KMS required during POC or just priced?
lina-sales: They plan to test rwd-medium, ~12 RPS steady with spikes to ~70 during batch imports. BYO-KMS required for prod; for POC they want it optioned and priced. Auditor specifically asked for a short ops statement + schematic.
reza-ops: We can pin tenant to EU regions (eu-west-1, eu-central-1, eu-north-1). Typical subprocessors: AWS (EC2/S3), Cloudflare (edge), Sentry (errors), Datadog (metrics). I can export CSV and include SOC2/ISO links.
reza-ops: Sample enforcement config we can share (sanitized): {"tenant":"datalock-poc","pin_region":"eu-west-1","geofence":true,"fallback":"none"}
sophie-legal: I can sign attestation after Sales/Ops upload the subproc CSV and routing wording. Need BYO-KMS liability bullets & quote numbers to complete review.
omar-se: Pricing note for quote: hosted short POC estimate includes egress premium ~€0.036/token; Dedicated reserved shows lower egress ~€0.009/token but requires commit. BYO-KMS add-on: one-time setup €1,700 + per-token handling €0.011. I'll add to the quote doc.
